NHMSeedsDescription: Plant these in Winter to grow a Northern Heart Melon. Needs {{NumberOfDays}} days to grow.
NHMelon.Description: A very rare fruit from a deity's garden that is said to increase a person's fondness towards another.
GlazedHeartMelon.Description: A sweet treat. Gifting it to someone shows that you really like them!
LoveTea.Description: A mysterious beverage that is said to make anyone like you instantly.
Tassel.Description: An equippable accessory (Ring slot). Increases luck, defense and critical stats.
GiftableTassel.Description: A beautiful handcrafted accessory, a token of companionship. Perhaps a certain ancient deity might appreciate this?
GiftedToNotOnAllowListMessage: I am sorry, this isn't really what I like. Why don't you make use of it yourself?
HeartMelonHuangjiu.Description: A type of traditional liquor brewed by mixing boiled grains such as rice, glutinous rice, or millet. This specific one has Northern Heart Melon added in, giving it a distinct flavor.
HuangjiuMail.title: How to make Huangjiu
HuangjiuMail.text: Hello, Farmer @! We of the Huangjiu Brewers' Association have been informed of your tremendous farming efforts and progress. As such, we would like to impart our knowledge on how to make Northern Heart Melon Huangjiu on you. Place a Northern Heart Melon in a keg in addition to 2 bags of unmilled rice. Why don't you give it a try?
HeartMelonPastry.Description: A sweet pastry with a jelly core made of Northern Heart Melons in the center.
HeartMelonDonut.Description: A reinterpretation of the beloved classic pastry, using the unique Northern Heart Melon to bring out the sweetest of flavors.
HeartMelonCandy.Description: Not too nutritious but sooo addicting!
HeartMelonSyrup.Description: A very sweet syrup made from extracting the juice of the Northern Heart Melon and letting it stir for a while. Can be used as a replacement for sugar.
GusQuestMail.title: Syrup needed
GusQuestMail.text: Hello @! I heard that you managed to cultivate a Northern Heart Melon. There are some pastries I would like to offer in my saloon, so could you be a dear and bring me four bottles of Heart Melon Syrup? ^ Gus
GusQuestCompleteMail.title: Syrupy thanks
GusQuestCompleteMail.text: Hello @! ^ Thank you for the bottles of syrup. Attached you will find the recipe I needed them for. I will also be selling some treats made from Heart Melons at my saloon from now on! Stop by anytime! ^ Gus
GusSyrup.title: Heart Melon Syrup wanted!
GusSyrup.text: Gus needs Heart Melon Syrup for a pastry he wants to make.
GusSyrup.objective: Bring Gus 4 bottles of Heart melon Syrup.
GusSyrup.reaction: Oh! Would you look at that! It's the syrup I asked for. Thank you, @.

config.Recipe Overrides.description: Change the recipes in the mod to use food categories as ingredients rather than a fixed type of item. Enables compatibility with other mods such as Cornucopia.
config.Growth Time.name: Growth Time
config.Growth Time.description: Change the time it takes for the Northern Heart Melon plant to grow.
